(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness less than 0.3mm and with a Young's modulus below __150 MPa__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises a silicone.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the speaker further comprises a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane (10) to the coil (8), and wherein the stiffening element provides additional support without substantially altering the Young's modulus of the membrane. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: A method of manufacturing a speaker, comprising: forming a membrane (10) from an elastomer, wherein the membrane has thickness less than 0.3mm and a Young's modulus below __150 MPa__; attaching a coil (8) to the membrane; and assembling the speaker by suspending the membrane (10), such that the coil (8) is positioned around a permanent magnet (2).
